## Message

I've drafted `specs/lock-closures-roadmap.md` (above) and will commit it on `main` once you approve. Track A is research, so only its core stage is committed. Stage 1 estimates how closure chance moves with upstream gauge level (O1) on real closure records and gauge readings. Its findings file records the curve and the measured cost of the real run. O2, O3 and O4 wait in the Ranked list in your order. After Stage 1 runs, a resume reports what it found and what it cost, and asks whether to re-rank.

One quality is left out of Stage 1 and needs your call. **Traceability** is needed because the trust's board will ask which gauge readings each closure estimate came from. As an outcome it would read: *"For every closure estimate, a record of the gauge readings it was fitted on."*

**Do you approve the Stage 1 partition, and do you approve traceability as an outcome? If you do, where should it rank among O2, O3 and O4? Or do you decline it?**

I'll record your answer in the file, commit it, and give you the line to start Stage 1 in a fresh session.
